recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical composition featuring a male subject in an urban setting, framed by a textured, scalloped border on the left containing large vertical text, and a smaller script-like title at the bottom right.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject leaning against a dark brick wall contrasting with a brightly lit concrete wall behind him.
Large-scale vertical sans-serif text on the left acting as a structural pillar.
High-contrast directional lighting creating a sharp shadow of the subject on the background wall.
Textured, dark brown border with a decorative scalloped edge separating the main image from the side panel.
coreInvariants: Vertical orientation of the primary display text.
Subject wearing a heavily embellished or studded vest.
Warm, slightly desaturated color palette with earthy tones.
Scalloped or 'postage stamp' style internal border edge.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned in the right two-thirds of the frame, shown from the waist up, angled toward the camera.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, pale yellow vertical text on the left side panel.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large vertical text, move to the subject's face, follow the body down to the smaller text in the bottom right corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Tight framing with minimal negative space, utilizing the walls to fill the background.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Dark brown and brick red tones in the background and borders.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale yellow/cream for the primary and secondary typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic silver from the studs on the vest.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the lit face/wall and the deep shadows.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold geometric sans-serif for the side; condensed high-contrast serif for the bottom.
letterConstructionRules: Side text: Uniform stroke weight, rounded corners on the exterior, tight tracking.
Bottom text: Extreme vertical elongation, thin hairlines, thick stems.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Vertical stacking of letters rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between a heavy, wide sans-serif and a tall, thin serif.
graphicDevices: Textured 'grunge' background in the side panel

preserve: Vertical orientation of the main name
Pale yellow color for all text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and rounded-geometric feel of the vertical text.
Matches the ultra-condensed, high-contrast serif style for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium shot of a man with 80s feathered hair wearing a silver-studded black vest, leaning against a dark brick corner in an alley. Harsh sunlight from the side creates a strong shadow on a concrete wall behind him. The left 25% of the image is a textured dark brown panel with a scalloped edge facing the photo.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large vertical text in a pale yellow bold sans-serif inside the left brown panel. Add a smaller, ultra-condensed serif title in the same pale yellow at the bottom right, overlapping the subject's waist.

verificationChecks: Is the main text rotated 90 degrees?
Does the subject have a studded vest?
Is the color palette dominated by brown and cream?

adjustableVariables: Texture intensity of the side panel
Specific stud pattern on the vest
Exact shade of the yellow text

mustAchieve: Distinct textural separation between the photo and the border

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the vertical text is legible and properly aligned within the side panel.
Check that the scalloped edge looks like a physical cutout or postage stamp edge.
Verify the high-contrast lighting on the subject's face is maintained.
Confirm the secondary text is sufficiently condensed.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Urban Portrait] + [Scalloped Side Panel] + [Vertical Bold Sans-Serif] + [Condensed Serif Overlay] + [80s Earth Tone Palette].
